acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Auto-expanding textarea that grows with content (max 6 lines, then scroll)
Send button enabled only when input is not empty
Send on Enter key, Shift+Enter for newline
File upload button with click and drag-and-drop support
Multiple file support (up to 10 files per message)
File type validation (images, PDFs, docs, spreadsheets)
File size validation with user-friendly error messages
Input disabled while Annie is responding
Character count indicator for long messages (optional)

doc.title: Epic 20: Annie Web UI
doc.snippet: Implement the message input area with text, file upload, and send functionality. Auto-expanding textarea (max 6 lines), send on Enter, Shift+Enter for newline, file upload with drag-and-drop, file type/size validation.

doc.title: Epic 20 Technical Context
doc.snippet: Defines AppState interface with conversations, messages, streamingMessage, sidebarOpen, annieState ('idle'|'thinking'|'speaking'|'tool_calling'), and action methods including addMessage and setStreamingMessage.

doc.title: Project Instructions
doc.snippet: FileAttachment schema includes filename, mime_type, size_bytes, data_base64. Supported types: images (10MB), documents/spreadsheets (20MB). Up to 10 files per message. Process-and-discard model - no persistence.

file.reason: Defines supported MIME types (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp, application/pdf, text/plain, text/csv, xlsx, docx), size limits (10MB images, 20MB docs), and MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST=10. Use for client-side validation mirroring.
ChatRequest model shows expected request format: user_id, platform, message, context, files (Optional[List[FileAttachment]]). Response includes conversation_id and stream_url for SSE.
SSE endpoint at /api/stream/{conversation_id}. Events: status, token, tool_call, tool_result, done, error. Stream format for client consumption.

constraints.constraint: Technology stack: Vite + React 18, shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS, Zustand for state
No SSR needed - SPA architecture with Vite
Files are process-and-discard - never persisted to disk or database
File content (base64) is NEVER logged - only metadata (filename, mime_type, size)
Image size limit: 10MB, Document size limit: 20MB
Send on Enter key, Shift+Enter for newline
Auto-expanding textarea max 6 lines, then scroll
POST /api/chat accepts JSON body, not multipart/form-data for files (base64 encoded)

interface.name: POST /api/chat
interface.request: { "user_id": "string (required)", "platform": "string (required) - 'web' for web UI", "message": "string (required, min_length=1)", "context": "object (optional, default={})", "files": "FileAttachment[] (optional, max=10)" }
